data: In fiscal 2025 (the year ended January 26, 2025), NVIDIA reported revenue of $130,497 million, up from $60,922 million in fiscal 2024. Cost of revenue was $32,639 million, leaving gross profit of $97,858 million, which works out to a gross margin of about 75.0%. Operating expenses totaled $16,405 million (R&D of $12,914 million and SG&A of $3,491 million), which left operating income of $81,453 million, or an operating margin of about 62.4%. For comparison, fiscal 2024 gross margin was about 72.7% and operating margin about 54.1%, so both measures expanded meaningfully year over year.
